problem: The sample items listed for the outer box Σ* include '11', but 11 is one of the four strings in the inner box L, since L is the set of all length-2 strings. In a nested drawing this puts the same string both inside and outside L.
fix: Use an outer-box sample that is not in L, e.g. items ['ε', '0', '101', '010'], and keep the inner box as ['00', '01', '10', '11'].

problem: The bars |·| are used with two different meanings: |w|=3 is the length of a string, while |L|=4 in the worked example is the number of elements of a set. A student reading quickly may take |L| as the length of L.
fix: Add one line where |·| first appears on a set: for a language L, |L| means the number of strings in L (its cardinality), while |w| on a string means length.
